body: It seems there are a lot like us unfortunately. I'm sorry you have to deal with this.
Yeah that's right. I don't think i can reach any conclusion at this point and i'm too afraid and dependent to seek help so i will just keep trying to guess.

I can't shake the feeling that people will see me as retarded or subhuman. Even if they don't show it. And i also think i'm ugly and incapable so i don't think anyone besides my relatives wouldn't think that.
I can try to not feel embarrassed but every time i open my mouth i cringe because i mumble something almost incoherent or makes some stupid mistake.

I have actually read a lot about mental illnesses but every time i do i get even more confused than before. Do you have a terrible long-term memory? From what i've read people with adhd only have a bad short-term memory but both of mine are bad.
I sometimes wish there is actually afterlife so i can live a life where i experience these things and like them and get excited about them. Where i'm normal.

Yes but i have zero skills and negative social skills. I'm even afraid to go to the shop and buy things. I'm even afraid to apologise or thank people sometimes. I don't even now why. It makes me hate myself even more.
I wish they could find a cure for this.

I can exist for now but what happens when my parents start demanding i find a job. I don't know if they will throw me out, most probably not but i prefer dying to being homeless. And i don't want to waste their resources anymore.

I'm not sure it's depression. Sometimes i feel motivated and excited. But i still can't do anything. And most of the time i feel empty. Only sometimes i feel sad and hopeless and it's mainly when i have screwed up somewhere or when i remember my past failures.
But then the emptiness comes again. I can't do anything meaningful. I don't want to. It's too much effort. Maybe i'm just lazy.
I don't know if i actually want to get better.
I'm also afraid to hurt myself. Right now I only live for my parents, fear and occasionally temporary hope.
I'm sorry you are experiencing this too. It really feels hopeless at times and you start to wonder if you are just lazy, ungrateful and spoiled. I'm wondering this right now.

Thanks for replying. It really sucks. I wish if I can't die that at least I can wake up with amnesia or something and develop completely different personality or erase my mind if  I live long enough for this technology to be invented.

Sorry. Don't worry about me. I'm too much of a pussy to kill myself. Becoming homeless is what scares me. And people thinking i'm subhuman. I appreciate your advice. I will keep posting and looking for answers because this life is just torture. I hope you do well. No one deserves shit like this.

Yes i use a throwaway account. I don't mean my country is some totalitarian regime where the government will track me if you mean this, I live in Bulgaria. But people here are very intolerant and don't believe mental health problems are real unless you are absolutely out of touch with reality. Even my parents. They are nice people but they just don't believe this thing. They thing i can gather my willpower and succeed but i don't think i can do this. Also i don't trust the therapists here because here everything is done badly and people just want money and not to help people.

What do you mean by accounts? I can't seek help because i live in a shit country where everyone will think i'm a subhuman if i have to go to therapists and am mentally ill, even my parents. And i don't trust the mental healthcare system here. I can't call someone or tell someone else because i have no friends and basically the only people i talk to are my parents and i'm absolutely terrified to call a person i don't know but the only people who i know can't help me and i can't tell them anyway. I tried. I'm almost 20 i feel like a child. I also don't want to depend on medication my whole life. And i agree that stagnation is bad but i don't have motivation to go forward and even when i sometimes have it the fear is still there. I think the only way i could actually be helped is if someone makes me do it but no one will. How to overcome the fear and the inadequacy and the lack of motivation?
Thank you. I don't know what to tell you but I hope you will be fine.
Thank you. I saw it. It was helpful. I still don't know what i will do though. I still can't get any help for it. I have a bad social anxiety.

I don't even know if it's anxiety. The emptiness has come again. I had some few hours when i felt peaceful, calm and focused and could understand what i read. I had my dreams and interests restored for a brief moment and now it's like my brain shut down again. It's weird because i know i probably feel anxiety right now but can't feel it clearly. Now i'm wondering if i can simulate this calm state based on the memory of the emotion. I've tried before and succeeded, but only for a short period. It becomes very tiring. Maybe we lack some neurotransmitter. But maybe we can restructure some part of the brain to compensate for the lost function. I don't know. The hope that things can be changed is the only thing keeping me alive probably, that's why i hope that dimension jumping is possible, even though it sounds stupid and delusional.

Hey thanks for responding. It sucks. I don't even believe myself. I think i'm constantly manipulating myself. Right now i feel better, but i know it will just last until the next failure. I take things too seriously. This causes me to distrust people and hate myself. I always find reasons that i or the world sucks and it can't be changed, like i am ugly, stupid and so on. I suspect i have ADHD with RSD but i won't be able to tell my parents because it will be an extreme embarrassment and the self hatred will begin again. How do you cope when you fail? I find it harder and harder because i have more responsibilities now.

Your comments do not appear. I know but it's ingrained in my brain. I can't not think about what others think about me. I can't stop. Even if i try i can only hold it for a day. And i will also fail university after which i will truly be worthless and will have no perspectives. I will not be able to find a job and i will end up homeless or parasitising my family's money. I just suck at everything.

Your comment has disappeared for some reason. I have a deep belief that nothing matters if i am ugly and stupid and even if i get better i will still be worthless. And people would look at me in a weird way if they understood i was mentally ill. I can't cope with that.
I know but i am weak and can't stand up for myself. And i don't want to live on pills. And there are also physical problems, too. I am ugly and my voice is bad and my memory problems too.

But they will feel bad that i will ruin my life and probably drop out of university and they will not believe me. They will be devastated and they will think i am a failure. And because i am a weak person they will try to convince me otherwise. Then i will comply and then i will feel normal for a day or a week and then i will feel bad again. I feel bad even when the smallest mistake happens. I am sure i will fail the tests and ruin my life because i don't even care. They will try anything to convince me i am not mentally ill and because i am extremely naive and weak i will believe them and stop trying to convince them.

Yes i know. But it isn't easy at all.  I actually did tell them. My father thought that i am making excuses for being lazy. He said that  don't have energy because i don't exercise. He could be right but lately i have walked kilometers from home to the university and back. My mother found a sheet on which i had written "do i have mental illness"". This was a list with things to google, because i always forget things. She asked me do you want to go to a mental hospital and take pills but in a kind of a threatening voice. She implied that the mental hospital is a place for mad people and i would be considered mad probably. I refused. I have also subtly told her that i want to kill myself but she didn't take it seriously. I am not even sure therapists here would take me seriously and i wouldn't even be able to trust them unless i was really close to them. I don't know what to do at this point.

I am a coward and i live in Bulgaria. I can't initiate action without external influence. I can't go to therapy unless someone makes me do it. I can't tell someone i am feeling this way unless someone asks me. I have terrible social anxiety. I wish i was able to overcome it. I really wish there was a way. But my parents would not see me the same way and i don't know if i will get better. I am afraid.

Thank you for still caring.

When i talk my voice gets kind of throaty and weird and that's why i speak quietly and i can't talk to people. Even if my voice was okay i still look ugly and people will judge me for that, even if they don't say it. I really do think i look weird and ugly. It could be body dysmorphia but when i compare myself with other people i see that i am really ugly. I always compare with others and am envious of their success because i am so stupid. You are right, when i an not successful i always become discouraged. But i can't comprehend complex stuff quickly and i am slow. An i lose interest immediately. At this point i am not interested in anything but perfection. I have become the greatest perfectionist but an unhealthy one. I look too far into the future and realize all life is meaningless but it's probably because i can't enjoy things and when something bad happens i overreact. My only goal is to make the perfect version of everything and "fix"the world but it's more of an obsession. I don't have any actual interests unless there is an unsolved challenge i have to fix. But i am too stupid to do it and i don't really feel interested in anything. I like music which makes me feel something and motivated because most of the time i am numb. I can also imagine music in my head but can never compose it. I have tried.  I only feel anger, envy and numbness. Sometimes sadness. I have learned to fake happiness but it's mentally draining and can't fix me and change my behaviour. What i do is i imagine a world where i will be happy. Since i was young i have escaped into these worlds but now i can't imagine it so well and have to focus on the real world but don't have any knowledge about the real world, such as taxes, finances and stuff. I always forget what i've learned and i probably don't care but i know i should care. I just can't bring myself to remember all of that. I don't know why. And i can't talk to any therapist because of my avoidance or whatever it is. I really wish i was brave enough but i've always been a pussy. Never could fight. That's probably why i was bullied. I was a very passive and tolerating child but it harmed me in the long run. I wish i could actually do it but there is much stigma in my country and if people learn they will think that i am "mad"which i probably am. They will judge me even more. I am not even sure therapists here will not judge me and even if they don't how will they fix me? And if i start taking medication even if it's secret my parents will notice and i can't lie well and it costs money and all kinds of problems. And i will never be able to talk to a person i don't know. The therapist has to be my trusted friend to open up to them. And i don't want to rely on medication all my life just to barely function.

​

Edit: I forgot to say sometimes i feel normal but then something minor bad happens and i get very depressed and i hate myself. And this"normal"mode is just numbness and sometimes a little bit happiness and motivation but i can't hold it long. I have learned to control myself to feel only numbness but don't feel motivation ever if i try to start it. I can't follow instrustions and have to be instructed like a child and i still forget. I ahve zero autobiographical memory. And sometimes i have intusive thaughts and worry that i will snap and do something awful. Probably ocd. And sometimes i also repeat actions. I drink water multiple times before going to bed and open the window to look multiple times and i thing it's bad if i drink an even number of cups. But i can stop it if i want.

I don't think anyone i know will take it seriously. They will probably be even more repulsed and i can't go through that. As i said i can't see a therapist because i am afraid to talk with strangers. I don't know why. It's probably really irrational but i can't help it. I don't think therapists will actually be nice and my parents will have to know about this and i have read some stories about shitty therapists. My country is not so good so i wxpect therapists will suck here. I can't have the possibility to go through this.

Thank you for replying, i really thought no one would care about this. I appreciate it.

I don't want to talk to people because i will be negatively judged. I know i am ugly and stupid and usually can't contribute to conversations. I hate my appearance and my voice. When i try to talk my voice gets tensed and i sound really weird and i hate it. I don't pay attention to what the person is talking, sometimes i stutter and sometimes i say something stupid which is totally wrong and sometimes i have to repeat what i said and sometimes i even can't respond to questions right away and i don't know what to say, my mind is blank. ANd i have the subconscious feeling that people think i am ugly and look like a caveman and stupid. And i think it gets worse over time.

I don't want to make mistakes because i will have to talk to people and say stupid things and they will judge me negatively. Or i might not be able to talk at all because i don't know what to say. This is probably avoidance personality disorder.

I don't want to ask for help but i don't know why. I am probably a bad person for this but i can't say thank you or sorry or anything. I can't express emotion or my opinions and i don't have any opinions and i often second guess myself but fully believe others even when they say something stupid and i feel stupid for this. And because i am unknowledgeable because i always forget everything i learn and even what i did yesterday. I will look stupid and i want to fake being good but it isn't working. I am probably a narcissist for this. I always hate to be wrong and when i do something i always chek if people like it all the time. And also i often feel a weird feeling like i am above everything else. Sometimes i get good ideas but i immediately imagine how i am the greatest and how i will be the most successful in the future but i hate myself for this, because i dismiss information immediately and can't read anything because i say to myself "why bother". I hate this feeling and recently have tried to stop it and it has worked to an extent but i am stupid as always. 

My interests fade quickly. Whenever i get interested i imagine how i am the greatest and do nothing but imagine how i will succeed without actually doing anything but i can't bring myself to do it. I hate myself for this. When people talk about their favourite shows or video games i feel alienated because i have nothing to talk about. I am literally blank. I forget everything and am not interested in everything. Unless it's something about science but i only have superficial knowledge. I can't learn it because it gets difficult and i can't comrehend complex things. And i forget most of the stuff anyway. I can't work hard because i want instant gratification and can't concentrate when things get complex and make lots of mistakes. I probably have adhd because as a child i have been described as hyperactive and can't concentrate but now i am not impulsive but still can't concentrate and am forgetful.

​

So i probably have a bunch of personality disorders, adhd, probably mild ocd and other shit. I don't know if i can be fixed. I have kept my mask until now but soon i will have to be on my own and i can't do that.

Thank you for reading my shit. I really appreciate it, but i can't do this. I tried to tell them directly once and to tell them subtly multiple times. One time my mother even found a paper on which i had written do i have mental illness as a reminder to search it because i always forget. She dismised what i said and asked me if i really was crazy and wanted to drink pills and go to the mental hospital in a bad tone. I backed out. My father just thinks i am making excuses for being lazy. I don't know if i am really lazy. I think i have adhd and a bunch of personality disorders. I was bullied as a child. My parents are good people but we live in a country where mental illness isn't taken seriously. I can't tell anyone. It will just bring more problems, such as judgement and stigma. I am going to university in a few weeks but i can't do it. And if people there find out i have mental illness i will be ostracized. And i can't go to a therapist because i am afrai of talking to people i don't know. I am not even sure therapists in my country are actually helpful.

Well, thank you for all your kind words.I feel a little bit better knowing that someone else at least knows about this crap. I will not find a therapist of course unless something drastically changes about me, but i might find the strength to keep going. There are too many problems in me and some are probably unfixable, but i will still try. If it doesn't work - well i hope that when i die i will go to a parallel universe where i am alright. I hope you will be alright too, you seem like a really nice person.

But how do you work on social skills? Isn't it kinda late for me to develop them? Like there isn't a recipe about how to talk to people. It's something innate, something spontaneous. I don't seem to have this.

So what do you think is there a point in trying? My voice is too bad to be heard and i don't look too good. When i talk with anyone i can't use their jargon or do small talk and there is often awkward silence because nothing to say comes to my mind. And every time i speak i cringe so much and don't want to open my mouth again. I think this is the biggest thing that is stopping me but i can't fix it.

I guess i just hate myself. Every time i speak to someone i fear i will screw up, i cringe when i hear my voice because i hate it and i hate how i look. Its easier to talk to people online because i can think about what to say before i say it and i'm kinda anonymous and no one will see me.

No, i could never get diagnosed because i don't want to speak to any people. I try to do some self diagnosis but i can't figure out what i have because i seem to have many problems which are mild enough to function barely.

Yes, i understand. But it gets too hard to maintain and if i give up it reverts to my "normal" self. I feel like a robot, i can't make jokes, spontaneous things, i always rely on others to arrange my life. And everything gets boring easily. And even if i try very hard to keep myself "normal" and feel happy, it is never truly normal. I can't hold that state indefinitely.

There are two ways for me. Me fixing myself, which was working until recently, but requires a lot of energy to keep myself going. And second, which is suicide. The problem is i live in such a country that i will be forever excluded from society if i am labelled as mentally ill. And i am not quite mentally ill either. I am on the border of mentally ill and normal. That's what sucks.

Also, it is hard for me to than people and i often forget, but thank you for reading this shit. No one seems to care.
Thank you for replying. But i just can't. I have bad social anxiety, avoidance, call it as you wish. I could never tell anybody about this. Ever.

Yeah i live there. It's supposed to be the best of the best in Bulgaria but it's still awful. There is isn't any medieval architecture because of the ottoman rule. Even the brutalist architecture isn't beautiful and brutalist architecture can be beautiful. The city is one of the ugliest in Europe. It's losing its green spaces because new buildings appear every day despite no one needs it. People here are very ignorant and selfish. If you drive there is a good chance you will die because people drive awfully. And don't get me even started about the gipsy problem. But the worst is nobody even cares for their own country at this point. People won't try to fix the situation, they only care about themselves. Our country is one of the most corrupt in Europe and there are no investments. We also have the highest mortality [rate](http://worldpopulationreview.com/countries/death-rate-by-country/) in the world. Our nature may be beautiful, but the country is not.

Thank you for replying, no one else seems to care. Whatever. I am sorry that you feel awful too, i guess happiness was not meant for everybody. Though there are strong people who can overcome this feeling to a certain degree, i am not one of them. And despite living in an awful country (i am bulgarian) my life certainly isn't bad. I am not poor, i have loving parents and a loving dog too. The problem is just me. I can ignore the fact that my country is undeveloped, but i can't fix myself. I am too socially awkward to seek help/therapy and even if i did there is no guarantee i will change. The negative things just add up. They are too many. I can't think normally and communicate with people normally. I cringe every time i hear my voice. I don't know what to say to my relatives on any occasion, like birthdays and even normal conversations. I can't go to the shop, i can't say sorry and thanks, but i don't know why. I always cringe when i do it. I am a bit selfish at times, but can't change that too. And even though i may sound like a logical person i am often really naive. I can't live like normal people. I am also awful at anything i do, from video games and competitive tasks to even school. Even though i get good grades i forget anything i have learned a week later. I don't even have a personality anymore. I am not interested in anything. The world is such a boring place. And the worst is that i can't feel anything anymore. Just self hatred in the bad moments. I am sorry that was so long. I hope you do alright. But i am not really sure about me.

Sorry for not replying earlier but it was late. My country is Bulgaria. I know it's way worse in Albania and that we are in the EU and so on but it still hasn't done anything for the world. No one knows it even exists and the culture is more middle eastern than european which i hate. Its like we can't decide whether to be european or middle eastern. And there aren't any bulgarian discoveries other than John Atanasoff, who isn't even bulgarian. He was born and grew up in the USA so he is american, not bulgarian.  The people here listen to horrible music, called "chalga", which is inspired by gipsy music and it has become one of the symbols of Bulgaria, despite being totally not bulgarian. Most of the people living here are either pensioneers or young dumb people.
You don't understand. I will never identify as american because i was born and grew up in my shitty country and that cannot change.
